text.en:
Act Numbered Two thousand and ninety- eight, entitled "An Act relating to contracts of personal
service and advances thereunder and providing punishment for certain offenses connected therewith," is
hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1927.
